verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party docs confirm a custom objects API that lets organizations represent data based on their own business requirements, and lets developers create, update and retrieve custom object records individually or in batches. The evidence never explicitly documents defining custom fields or properties on those objects, or associating custom objects with each other or with built-in objects. Import associations are shown only for standard objects like companies and deals. Missing for 10: documented custom object schema and field definition, documented associations and relationships for custom objects, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals

citations.quote: HubSpot custom objects allow organizations to represent and organize data based on unique business requirements. Create and update custom object records with the custom objects API.
You can retrieve custom object records individually or in batches.
use the objects API to create and manage the custom object’s records
